caption: The drawing features a wooden chest with a light brown color, angular dovetail joints at the corners, and a slightly domed lid with two parallel wooden ridges. The front face of the chest displays two rectangular panels, each decorated with a pattern of tulip-like flowers in red and orange, green stems and leaves, set in a black pot-shaped vase. The panels are placed side by side and have a white background, contrasting with the light brown color of the rest of the chest. The chest is set against a plain, off-white rectangular background bordered by a single black line. There is a small, rounded compartment attached to the right side of the chest, matching the wood tone and featuring small round nails.
title: Dough Trough
